items.label: diagnosis
items.evidence:
there are only two options for a `DataArray` processed within `map()`:
1. Get a direct copy (really, reference) to the original `DataArray`'s `.attrs`
2. Have `.attrs` set to `{}`
items.rationale: Identifies the mechanism in Dataset.map: with keep_attrs it copies original attrs over the result, otherwise clears them, so function-set attrs are lost. The reference changes exactly this logic in Dataset.map. It does not propose a specific fix, though it implies leaving function-set attrs alone.
